caption:
Mountain biking in Costa Rica means learning to read the landscape, not just the map. On these high, grassy ridges, a gravel road can turn into a cattle path in the space of a single turn, leaving you to find your own line through the green. There are no traffic signs here, no pavement, and no crowds—just the sound of your tires on wet grass and the long, silent valleys dropping away on either side. It is a place that asks you to slow down, look up, and decide exactly how you want to meet the terrain.
